newsitem.title: INDIA: Brooke Bond India H1 96 sales, net up.
newsitem.headline: Brooke Bond India H1 96 sales, net up.

text.p: Unilever Plc subsidiary Brooke Bond Lipton India Ltd said it recorded a net profit of 474.5 million rupees for the first half of calendar 1996, showing a 14 percent rise over the year ago period.
It said net sales during the first half of 1996 rose to 10.67 billion rupees, up from 9.89 billion rupees in the year ago period.
The board of directors on Wednesday approved an interim dividend of 2.7 rupees, up from 2.0 rupees interim paid in the year-ago period, the company said in a statement.
"Sales turnover in packet tea in the period January to June 1996 has increased by 21 percent with all key brands recording handsome gains," it said.

"Tea exports to Russia, Central Asia, the Arabian and Egyptian markets have grown handsomely and Brooke Bond, along with its wholly owned subsidiary Lipton India Exports Ltd, retains its position as India's largest exporter of tea by value," the company said.
It said the coffee business also recorded a sharp turnaround.
